subject: 🏃 Wednesday — Heavy Strength (Wk 3)
html:
Tomorrow: Heavy Strength at Cañada College. Week 3, full Rx. Four exercises, 3-second eccentrics on every rep. This is the third heavy session in the V6 plan and the data says you're ready — knee has been 1/5 for two straight days post-B2B, and your last heavy day (May 13) cleared all four lifts clean.

Warm-up: Foam roll quads/IT band 1 min each, glute bridges 10 reps, quadruped hip CARs 3 each leg, bodyweight squats 10 reps, RDL pattern with empty bar 10 reps.

The lifts:

ExerciseWeightSets × RepsNotes
Back Squat155 lb4 × 63-sec eccentric, hips break first
Romanian Deadlift155 lb (straps)4 × 6Progress to 165 only if clearly Easy
Standing Calf Raise40 lb/hand DBs4 × 10Full ROM on step, 2-sec hold at top. Progress to 45 only if clearly Easy
Reverse NordicBodyweight3 × 10Build depth past 45° — no rush to full mat

Progression call: RDL and calf raise both logged "Good leaning light/Easy" on May 13. If either feels clearly Easy tomorrow — meaning 4+ reps in the tank — bump RDL to 165 and calves to 45 lb/hand. If they feel Good (2–3 RIR), hold. The knee had a 2/5 reading on Sunday, and while it's been clean since, I'd rather see one more green heavy session at current weights before pushing load. Don't force a bump.

Focus cue: Squeeze the eccentric. Three full seconds on every squat and RDL descent — count "one-Mississippi" in your head. The slow lowering phase is where the tendon adaptation happens, and that's what protects the knee at mile 20.

Context: Week 3 of 12, Phase 1 Foundation — 67 days to race day. Thursday is a 6 mi progression run (4 mi easy + 2 mi threshold by HR), so the legs will feel today's squats tomorrow morning. That's expected and logged as a known confounder. The May 30 PAL 10K is 10 days out.

Tonight: Eat a solid dinner with protein — aim for 30–40g (fish + rice or a big lentil bowl). Lay out gym clothes and straps tonight, bed by 10. You're in a good rhythm.
